# Appendices

## Appendix 1: Description of the entity dataset {#entityFields}


```{r}
block_caption("Description of the fields included in the entity simulation configuration file. NJA = National Jurisdiction Area", 
              style = "Table Caption", 
              autonum = run_autonum(seq_id = 'tab', 
                                    bkm = "App2", 
                                    start_at = 1, 
                                    pre_label = "Tab. A", 
                                    prop = fp_text_lite(bold = TRUE))
)

entity_metadata = data.table(openxlsx::read.xlsx("../inputs/data/metadata_configuration_file.xlsx", sheet = "entities", sep.names = " "))

entity_metadata[`Field name` == "NJA_SIZE", `Example / Format` := prettyNum(`Example / Format`, big.mark = ",")]

entity_metadata %>% 
  flextable::flextable() %>% 
  flextable::font(part = "all", fontname = "Calibri") %>% 
  flextable::fontsize(part = "all", size = 9) %>% 
  flextable::align(part = "header", align = "center") %>% 
  flextable::bold(part = "header") %>% 
  flextable::bg(part = "header", bg = "gray") %>% 
  flextable::border_inner(border = fp_border()) %>%
  flextable::border_outer(border = fp_border(width = 2)) %>% 
  flextable::width(width = c(2.2, 3, 1.4))
```
